posts.title: Journal (2026-11-09) - Texas Linux Fest and Austin
posts.description: I made it back home late in the evening after attending Texas Linux Fest in Austin. I was in Austin two nights for the event, which all went well. Most of the keynotes seemed focused around chat bots this time though, which granted, seems to be the direction of the tech world these days. It's not my cup of tea, but some of it was interesting.
